name: Barrelhauberk
description: Hold the emptied pistol by the barrel like a short club as the foe closes for the kill.

name: Barrel Maelstrom
description: Lift the second pistol from the belt while the first is still smoking in the other hand.

name: Might Pistolgrip
description: Step off the line the instant the first shot leaves, before the foe can answer.

name: Cleaving Cylinder
description: Crouch inside the shot's smoke and begin the next charge where the foe cannot see the hands.

name: Glint Hammer
description: Cock the hammer with a flick of qi so the second report follows the first by a bare heartbeat.

name: Chimebarrel
description: Watch the foe's body after the first shot and take the second only when he commits to his move.

name: Dominating Quickdraw
description: Throw the spent pistol overarm at the foe's chest and fire the second as he flinches from it.

name: Lanyardring Thrash
description: Send two balls down one line of qi so the second follows the first through the same wound.

name: Lotpistol
description: Chain the first shot, the thrown pistol and the second shot into one flowing beat that leaves the foe no gap.

name: Chimehammer
description: Let the living qi field reach the barrel's tip as the pistol is drawn and aimed.

name: Unmaking Pointblank
description: Seed the powder charge with a thin thread of qi as it is poured so it burns evenly.

name: Rupturing Triggerbar
description: Seat the ball with a short pulse of qi through the ramrod and feel it settle in the bore.

name: Hoarfrost Frizzen
description: Wave a palm through the smoke to clear it away and open the line to the next shot.

name: Pistolelixir
description: Settle the qi field against the grip and feel the shooting hand's smallest tremor.

name: Grinding Flashpan
description: Wrap the ball in a bright film of qi so it lands harder than powder alone could drive it.

name: Muzzleassault
description: Hold a continuous thread of qi along the bore so the ball keeps its line over a long arc.

name: Hipshot Hauberk
description: Let a pulse of qi ring from the falling hammer and jar the foe's guard hand.

name: Nova Thumbback
description: Spin a thread of qi around the ball in the bore so it bites through plate and padding.

name: Lambasting Foresight
description: Gather the field over several breaths, then loose a rapid string of qi-laden balls across the foe's whole line of advance.

name: Glintreport
description: Pause at the threshold with the muzzle already across the room before the shoulder enters.

name: Waning Frizzen
description: Sweep the barrel along each corner in turn, reading the dark places for a hidden body.

name: Rumble Snapfire
description: Slam the shoulder through a door and fire into the first foe thrown off balance.

name: Muzzle Sprint
description: Vault a low bench in one stride and land with the pistol already aimed.

name: Hammer Onslaught
description: Stand in the doorway and fire at each foe who looks up, so none can rise to meet the rest.

name: Torrent Report
description: Cross the bright pool of a window quickly and keep to the shaded wall beyond it.

name: Stifling Pointblank
description: Bar a doorway with a fan of shots and qi so any foe who steps toward it is checked at once.

name: Muzzletorment
description: Pivot through the room firing at each foe in turn so several fall back before the circuit is done.

name: Tearing Cylinder
description: Run the whole drill from stance to draw to aimed shot in the space of a few breaths.

name: Chime Foresight
description: Reset the grip between shots and run a thumb along the barrel to feel for damage or heat.

name: Granite Triggerbar
description: Back away with the muzzle lowered but ready, giving ground without turning the shoulder.

name: Gustbarrel
description: Raise the barrel before the face and turn a falling blow along the iron.

name: Needling Quickdraw
description: Drive the heavy butt in a short strike to the foe's ribs from inside his reach.

name: Rumble Lanyardring
description: Prime the pan by feel alone in the dark, thumb and horn working without the eyes.

name: Rumblebarrel
description: Run a line of qi down the bore and let it point the shot where the eye cannot.

name: Hastening Hipshot
description: Match each reloading motion to a stride so the shooter never stands still while charging.

name: Transfixing Thumbback
description: Pass the pistol to the off hand mid-motion and fire again from the unexpected side.

name: Snapfire Cloak
description: Fire to fill the air with smoke, then drift sideways behind it so the foe loses the shooter.

name: Compounding Barrel
description: Answer each of the foe's blows with one calm, fitted shot and step until the foe breaks his own rhythm.

name: Daybreak Pistolgrip
description: Tune the lock's spring to the shooter's own qi so every hammer fall lands with the pulse.

name: Torrent Thumbback
description: Stand with both arms spread low like a hawk's wings, a loaded pistol in each hand.

name: Barrelassault
description: Sweep both pistols from the belt in a single outward arc and level them together.

name: Chime Cylinder
description: Cross the arms and fire both pistols so the two balls meet at the foe's chest.

name: Hardened Hammer
description: Fold both arms in before the body so the paired barrels cover the throat and heart.

name: Gust Frizzen
description: Turn on one foot while the other mirrors it, the pistols swinging in matched arcs.

name: Lancing Flashpan
description: Prime both pans at once with one sweep of the horn so the pistols fire together.

name: Blaze Flashpan
description: Fire left then right in a steady cadence so the foe cannot find a gap between reports.

name: Foresight Hauberk
description: Cross both barrels like shears over the foe's weapon arm and wrench it off its line.

name: Wrecking Report
description: Pass the qi from the right pistol arm to the left at the instant the right pistol empties.

name: Hour Muzzle
description: Gather qi in both arms, then spread the wings and loose a fan of shots that pins a whole flank.

name: Ravaging Report
description: Drop low like a stooping hawk and fire both pistols upward on one qi pulse through the foe's guard.

name: Scorching Hipshot
description: Rest the pistol arm on a rock rim and loose one patient shot across the open ground below.

name: Muzzleleap
description: Curve the body round the foe's flank in a smooth bend while the barrel stays upon him.

name: Novareport
description: Lay the front sight on the horizon line of the foe's shoulders and fire along that blue edge.

name: Torrent Triggerbar
description: Step across the foe's cut like a stone in a ford and turn it with the barrel.

name: Glintmuzzle
description: Read the flow of the foe's movement and aim ahead to where the current will carry him.

name: Surging Pistolgrip
description: Slip aside into the still pocket behind the foe's rush and return fire as he passes.

name: Remnant Lanyardring
description: Fire into damp ground to kick up a silt-brown cloud that hides the shooter's next step.

name: Pistolassault
description: Lay the shot not at the foe but at the place his flowing movement must pass, and loose it as he arrives.

name: Drubbing Pointblank
description: Gather qi like a swelling river, then loose a rolling line of balls that sweeps the foes from the bank.

name: Hoarfrost Pistolgrip
description: Let the muzzle lead the stepping foot by half a beat so shot and stride share one rhythm.

name: Glancing Barrel
description: Move the front foot in the same beat that the pistol hand lifts to the mark.

name: Blaze Muzzle
description: Draw on the left beat of a stride and stop dead on the right to fire true.

name: Facet Hammer
description: Turn the stepping foot inward to present the shoulder and set the pistol arm behind it.

name: Hammercloak
description: Rap the barrel across a lunging blade while the feet keep their own course.

name: Hoarfrost Thumbback
description: Fire from the hip on the footfall, the stride and the report landing together.

name: Glint Foresight
description: Pour the charge in the swing of a walking stride, never pausing to take the powder.

name: Pistolhauberk
description: Swing the pistol one way while the feet go the other, so the foe tracks the wrong one.

name: Lot Lanyardring
description: Keep hand and foot moving in unbroken alternation so every shot is taken in motion and none at rest.

name: Raging Triggerbar
description: Plant the stepping foot and let the pivot throw a qi-driven shot that leaves the barrel with the turn.

name: Rumblepistol
description: Measure the charge for two balls in one pour so both ride a single burst of powder.

name: Hoarfrost Quickdraw
description: Draw one breath, level the barrel on it and fire as the lungs hold still.

name: Discerning Muzzle
description: Narrow the eye to the hawk's stare and read the foe's guard from the front sight.

name: Hipshot Thrash
description: Let the wrist share the recoil of the doubled charge and settle back on the mark.

name: Blaze Report
description: Ram two balls down the bore with a thread of qi between them so neither rolls loose.

name: Chime Flashpan
description: Feed the pan a single spark through qi so the doubled charge lights without a hangfire.

name: Facetbarrel
description: Loose both balls on one qi breath so they strike the same target almost at once.

name: Cleaving Pointblank
description: Bend the two balls apart with qi on a divided line so they strike two foes side by side.
